question: Does the 60-day booking limit apply to the Taj Express?
ground_truth_answer: No. Day-time express trains like the Taj Express and Gomti Express keep their existing lower advance reservation limits.

question: Which trains go from Jaipur (JP) to Udaipur City (UDZ)?
ground_truth_answer: 2 trains: 12315 Ananya Express and 12965 Gwalior Udaipur Express.
